import os,pathlib,subprocess,json,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
version=os.environ['AGENTS_VERSION']
dest=pathlib.Path('/tmp/agents-mutations-'+version);dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
results=[]
for kind,file,selector in [
 ('code_mentions','test_board_messages.py','test_container_and_fence_boundaries_preserve_prose_destinations or test_code_mentions_do_not_hide_adjacent_prose_destinations'),
 ('accept_draft','test_parent_session.py','test_changed_or_incomplete_review_targets_fail_closed and draft'),
 ('ignore_cancellation','test_parent_development.py','test_completed_parent_distinguishes_confirmed_cancellation_from_success and (body or state_reason)'),
]:
    junit=dest/(kind+'.xml'); log=dest/(kind+'.log'); applied=dest/(kind+'-applied.log')
    command=[str(pathlib.Path('.venv/bin/python').absolute()),'-m','pytest','-n','1','--dist=worksteal','--no-cov','-q','--junitxml='+str(junit),'tests/e2e/agents_ops/'+file,'-k',selector]
    env={**os.environ,'OMP_NUM_THREADS':'1','MKL_NUM_THREADS':'1','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS':'1','CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES':'','PYTHONPATH':'/tmp:'+str(pathlib.Path.cwd()),'PYTEST_PLUGINS':'agents_defect_observer','AGENTS_MUTATION':kind,'AGENTS_MUTATION_LOG':str(applied)}
    with log.open('w') as out: proc=subprocess.run(command,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    tree=ET.parse(junit);suites=tree.findall('testsuite');messages=[failure.get('message','') for failure in tree.iter('failure')];row={'mutation':kind,'command':command,'exitcode':proc.returncode,'tests':sum(int(s.get('tests')) for s in suites),'failures':sum(int(s.get('failures')) for s in suites),'errors':sum(int(s.get('errors')) for s in suites),'applied_calls':len(applied.read_text().splitlines()) if applied.exists() else 0};row['failure_messages']=[message[:1600] for message in messages];results.append(row); print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
    if not (row['exitcode']==1 and row['errors']==0 and row['failures']==row['tests'] and row['tests']>0 and row['applied_calls']>=row['tests']):raise RuntimeError(row)
    if any('TimeoutExpired' in message or 'timed out' in message for message in messages):raise RuntimeError('timeout is not defect detection')
    if kind=='code_mentions' and not all('sender cannot be a recipient' in message for message in messages):raise RuntimeError('unexpected code-mention failure')
(dest/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
